body:
`_Logger.error_or_exception` still branches on `sys.version_info > (3, 7)`,
with an else-branch calling `self.exception(message, stack_info=True, ...)`.
The shipped image is Python 3.13, so the else-branch is unreachable and the
condition is always true.

Dead code on an error path is worse than dead code elsewhere: it is the code
people read when diagnosing a failure, and it implies a supported
configuration that does not exist.

Found while fixing #1556 (PR #1587). Left out of that diff on purpose — the
fix was a signature change and widening it would have grown blast radius on
a module every other module imports.
title: logger.py carries a dead sys.version_info > (3, 7) branch
